QUOTE: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566`) takes a caller buffer and carves it into blocks with magic-number headers. It then calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` with its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer shows the buffer allocator's init calling the setter, but it never says this is the only in-tree user. It also says "the same hook the library's own allocator uses" and never names MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C.
